DEL removes this pill.","ca-order":"100"},"$:/plugins/rimir/cascade-palette/readme":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/cascade-palette/readme","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"! What it does

A keyboard-driven cascading command palette for TiddlyWiki. Hit one hotkey (default: ''Ctrl-Space'') to open. Type to filter a stage. ''→'' (Right-arrow) drills into a stage. ''Space'' opens the action menu on typed rows (works on containers too). ''Esc'' walks one stage back, ''Shift-Esc'' closes from any depth. ''Enter'' fires the selected action. Domain plugins (e.g. `rimir/orga-palette`) extend the palette by shipping declarative ''entry'' and ''action'' tiddlers — no widget code required.

! Key features

* ''Cascading stages'' — every drill pushes a new stage; ArrowLeft / Esc pops one stage at any depth, Shift-Esc closes from any depth. Breadcrumb shows where you are.
* ''Declarative protocol'' — adding a new cascade is one tiddler. Tag, fields, done.
* ''Generic engine'' — no domain knowledge baked in. Same widget serves any catalogue plugin.
* ''Multi-view root menu'' — switch between ''Entries'' / ''All tiddlers'' / ''By namespace'' / ''By parent'' / ''Hybrid'' / ''By date'' views from a pill strip above the input. Each view is a composition of one or more ''channels'' (`ca-view-channels` lists them) — each channel declaring its own `roots` + `children` filters, row decorations, and optional `row-entity-type` for context-action drilling. A focusable ''Structure'' strip below the view pills makes the active view's composition externally visible: compact by default (one summary row with view name + channel-count + view-scoped pills), expandable on Enter/Space/→ to a full stacked layout (view-scoped header + one mini-row per channel with all primitive pills). Arrow keys navigate the expanded grid; each focused pill renders contextual help into the details drawer. Entries can opt into per-view placement via `ca-position-<view-slug>` fields. Add your own views as tiddlers tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/view` and your own channels as tiddlers tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/channel`.
* ''Grouping axes'' — any channel can declare a chain of ''axes'' that bucket the channel's source set at the top of the descent: year → month → day, status → year, prefix → tag, anything you can write as a one-filter derive-key. Axes ''compose with'' the channel's recursive `children` filter — so the same channel can be pure grouping (axes only), today's recursive tree (children only), or both (bucket the forest roots, then descend each). Edit chains live from the Structure strip: yellow ''by'' / ''→'' pills in each channel's mini-row, ''+'' pill to append, Backspace to remove, Shift-←/→ to reorder, Enter to swap. Ship axes as tiddlers tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/axis` — `ca-axis-key` is a one-line filter mapping rows to bucket keys.
* ''Leader keys'' — type a single char and idle for 200ms to fire a shortcut: `x` clears all filter+visibility pills, `>` opens a tree-picker that commits a path as a title-prefix filter, `s` saves the current state as a named preset, `r` jumps focus to the preset strip. Every visible leader is also surfaced as a pill in the ''Leader'' strip above the input, so the available gestures are discoverable without prior knowledge — Tab into the strip, ←/→ to select, ↵/Space to fire. Leaders may be view-scoped via ''`ca-leader-views`'' (a filter producing view titles) — empty / missing means global. Author your own as tiddlers tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/leader`.
* ''Presets'' — save any combination of active view + filter pills + visibility pills under a name; replay later by picking the preset's pill. Tiddlers tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/preset`.
* ''Filter strip'' — type `/foo`, `prefix:work/`, `#tag`, `@<tiddler>` to stack ''filter'' pills that narrow every result list. Tiddlers tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/filter`.
* ''Visibility strip'' — type `hide:appify` to hide entries by group, or Shift-DEL on a root row to hide a single entry. Tiddlers tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/visibility`. Ctrl-DEL clears both filter and visibility strips.
* ''Filter substitution'' — `<<query>>`, `<<picked>>`, `<<parent-picked>>`, `<<context-tiddler>>` available in every filter and action. Filter/visibility expressions also see `<arg>` and `<<arg>>`. Inside a preview-bearing subtree, `<<stage-preview-context>>` exposes the entity the side preview is pinned to.
* ''Sticky context'' — pin one or more tiddlers (Space → ''Pin to context'', or type ''`+<title>`'' + Enter for a one-handed pin) and they appear as the ''Context'' pill strip + the `<<sticky-context-list>>` / `<<sticky-context-count>>` variables exposed to every filter/action scope. ''Page-session only'' — reload clears it (capture as a preset if you need cross-reload memory). Views opt in to narrowing by referencing the variable in their channel filters AND declaring ''`ca-view-context-aware: yes`'' to paint a small badge when context is non-empty. Generic verbs (Pin / Unpin / Clear) ship here; workflow-specific verbs (call, meeting, focus) belong in a sibling plugin like ''`rimir/worga`''.
* ''Row icons'' — small glyphs in a footer strip below tiddler-bearing rows, surfacing affordances on the row's backing tiddler. Shipped: a ''🌐'' glyph appears on any tiddler whose configured URL field(s) carry an http/https/ftp/mailto/tel value (default field: ''`url`'' — configurable via ''`$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/url-fields`''). ''Alt-↵'' on a row with at least one icon (or clicking the glyph directly) fires the primary icon's action — for ''🌐'' that opens the URL in a new browser tab; ''Ctrl-Alt-↵'' fires the icon's secondary action — for ''🌐'' that copies the URL to the clipboard. Author your own via tiddlers tagged ''`$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/row-icon`''.
* ''Actionable-row indicator'' — every row whose tiddler has at least one applicable action (via catalogue / configured-field bridge / `ca-applies` filter) gets a thin indigo bar at its leading edge (`rcp-row-actionable` class) AND a right-edge ''`→N`'' badge counting the available actions. Lets you scan ↑/↓ down a long list and see where Space will actually open something — no speculative keystrokes. Three discovery paths unioned: ''catalogue'' (action `ca-entity-type` matches the row's bound type — set by `ca-channel-row-entity-type` on the emitting channel); ''configured-field bridge'' (when an installed plugin sets `$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/entity-type-field` to a field name, e.g. `kind` ships it as `kind.type` — action `ca-entity-type: <X>` then auto-matches any row whose tiddler has `<configured-field>: <X>`); ''filter'' (action declares `ca-applies` — filter evaluated with `<currentTiddler>` = row title, non-empty result = applies). All three further narrowed by per-action `ca-action-when`. Per-view opt-out via `ca-view-show-action-preview: no`.
* ''Lenses (row decorations)'' — a ''lens'' projects one or more decoration slots onto every data row: ''name'' (replace the displayed name), ''icon'' (a leading glyph), or ''annotation'' (a trailing badge). Each slot is its own single-select chooser strip below the view strip; pick a lens, ''(off)'' to disable, or ''➕ New…'' to author one in-palette (type its projection filter with a live match-count; rows decorate as you type). Ships with three ''name'' lenses — ''Title'', ''Caption'', and ''Caption → Title'' (default: captioned tiddlers caption-first, everything else by title) — generic ''Modified'' (filter) and ''Tags'' (template) ''annotation'' lenses, and, with `rimir/kind`, a ''Kind'' ''icon'' lens showing each instance's `kind.icon`. A lens slot is a filter (cheap) or a `ca-lens-<slot>-template` (rich wikitext) evaluated per row with `<currentTiddler>`, so a row reads consistently regardless of which view surfaced it; a lens can also contribute always-on ''actions'' (`ca-lens-actions`) — the Kind lens owns the kind Open / Edit / Delete actions, available even with the icon slot off. Author / edit / delete in-palette: the ''Manage lenses'' entry lists every lens — drill a lens for a per-facet editor (name, when, default slots, each slot's filter + template, actions, delete; templates and actions editable here, no hand-authoring) — plus a ''+ New…'' creator per slot; or use the per-slot ''➕ New…'' pill / ''e'' to edit / ''DEL'' to delete; or tag a tiddler `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/lens` with a `ca-lens-<slot>-filter`. Picks persist across reload (`$:/state/rimir/cascade-palette/lens/<slot>`). Static palette entries / actions keep their explicit `ca-name`; only data rows are decorated.
* ''Side preview pane'' — right-column pane that opens when the user drills into a row whose menu declared a preview (or whose context matches a tagged auto-attach candidate). Two registration mechanisms work in parallel: ''per-menu'' — an entry/action sets ''`ca-preview-template`'' (+ optional ''`ca-preview-context`'' filter / ''`ca-preview-title`'' caption / ''`ca-preview-name`'' pill label), explicit and pinned at drill-time; ''tag-based'' — any tiddler tagged ''`$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/side-preview`'' is a candidate whose ''`ca-preview-applies`'' filter is evaluated against the active context, auto-attaching whenever it matches (no per-menu wiring needed). When two or more candidates apply at the same context, a pill row appears at the top of the pane — ←/→ when the pane has focus cycles between them (also click). The cascade visually shrinks to 50% on the left; the pane stays mounted while the registering stage (or any deeper one) is on the stack, then disappears when the user pops past. Use it to live-render a form for the kind being edited, a chart of the data being filtered, etc. Distinct from the ''detail'' drawer (the Ctrl-hold / always-on row below the menu), which is bound to the selected row.
* ''Keyboard-first'' — Up/Down to select, Tab to cycle sections (input → preset → visibility → filter → view → structure → leader → menu → detail → preview), Shift-Tab to jump between the pill-group and the main group, Esc to walk one stage back (closes only at root from input), Shift-Esc to close from any depth, Enter to fire. ''→'' drills (descend tree containers / open the action menu on typed catalogue leaves); ''Space'' opens the action menu on ''any'' tiddler row whose actions match via `ca-applies` — works in tree views (By namespace, By parent, Hybrid), not only in the catalogue. Left/Right inside the input preserve normal cursor behaviour. ''Type-ahead'' — start typing a printable character from any section and focus jumps back to the input with the character appended, so you never have to Tab back just to keep filtering.

! Prerequisites

* TiddlyWiki ≥ 5.4.0

! Quick start

Install the plugin, restart. Ctrl-Space opens the palette. Out of the box you get four demo entries (Open Control Panel, Save Wiki, Advanced Search, Recent Tiddlers…) so you can confirm it's working. The real value is in shipping your own ''entry'' and ''action'' tiddlers — see the [[Documentation]] tab for the protocol.

To rebind, edit the tiddler `$:/config/shortcuts/rimir-cascade-palette-open`.

! Extending: the action-tiddler protocol

* ''Entry tiddlers'' — root-stage menu items. Tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/entry`.
* ''Action tiddlers'' — what appears in the action menu for a picked entity. Tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/action`, scoped via `ca-entity-type` field.

Each tiddler declares whether it's a ''leaf'' (fires actions on Enter and closes) or a ''drill'' (pushes a new stage). Cascades form an implicit graph: a drill from type A → type B is just a tiddler with `ca-entity-type: A` and `ca-next-entity-type: B`. Add a new edge by writing one tiddler.

See the Documentation tab's ''Protocol'' section for full schema and worked examples.

! Cascade Palette

The palette has two channels of configuration:

* ''Settings rows'' — interactive rows inside the palette itself (open with the hotkey, navigate to ''Settings''). Toggle / number / text inputs that write to `$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/*` config tiddlers.
* ''Raw config tiddlers'' — direct edits at `$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/*` for advanced settings without a UI row (deep-search tuning, etc.).

Both are listed below — UI-surfaced settings are marked ''Settings row available''; others are raw-edit only.

! Hotkey

;<code>$:/config/shortcuts/rimir-cascade-palette-open</code>
:The keyboard shortcut that opens the palette. Default ''Ctrl-Space''. Standard TW shortcut tiddler — edit directly to rebind, no restart needed. ''Settings row available'' (under ''Settings'' inside the palette).

! Behaviour

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/max-results</code>
:Caps the number of items rendered per stage. Default 30. ''Settings row available''.

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/popup-width</code>
:CSS width of the popup container (e.g. ''`820px`''). Default 820. ''Settings row available''.

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/details-always-on</code>
:If ''`yes`'', the details drawer below the result list stays open (instead of requiring Ctrl-hold). Default ''`no`''. ''Settings row available''.

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/pin-pill-rows</code>
:If ''`yes`'', every pill strip (Visibility, Reach, Meta, Field, Filter) is rendered even when no pills are pushed. Useful as a dev / discoverability aid — lets you see where each strip sits before populating it. Default ''`no`''. ''Settings row available''.

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/soft-depth-warning</code>
:Engine logs a console warning when the stage stack exceeds this depth. Default 10. No hard cap — this is purely a development aid. ''Settings row available''.

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/show-perf-footer</code>
:Toggle a small diagnostic footer with recompute / render timings and item counts. Off by default. ''Settings row available''.

! Row icons

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/url-fields</code>
:Space-separated field list scanned by the built-in 🌐 row-icon. First field whose value matches an `http://` / `https://` / `ftp://` / `ftps://` / `mailto:` / `tel:` prefix wins; rows with a match get a 🌐 glyph in their footer strip that opens the URL in a new tab on Alt-↵ or click. Default ''`url`''. Raw-edit only.

! Lenses (row decorations)

A ''lens'' decorates each data row's ''name'' (replace), ''icon'' (leading glyph) or ''annotation'' (trailing badge) slot. Each slot is a single-select chooser strip below the view strip; pick a lens, ''(off)'' to disable, or ''➕ New…'' to author one in-palette (also via the ''Manage lenses'' menu entry). Lenses never touch static palette entries — only data rows.

;<code>$:/state/rimir/cascade-palette/lens/<slot></code>
:Tiddler title of the active lens for ''<slot>'' (`name` / `icon` / `annotation`), or empty = slot off. Written when you pick a lens in the slot's strip; survives reload, not filesystem-synced. First load seeds the slot's default — a lens whose ''`ca-lens-default`'' slot-list includes this slot (shipped: ''Caption → Title'' defaults the ''name'' slot). Author lenses in-palette, or by tagging tiddlers ''`$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/lens`'' with a ''`ca-lens-<slot>-filter`'' (and optional ''`ca-lens-when`'' / ''`-name`'' / ''`-chip`'' / ''`-hint`'' / ''`-help`'' / ''`ca-order`'').

! Action discovery

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/entity-type-field</code>
:A single field name that auto-bridges catalogue actions to every view. When set, an action's `ca-entity-type: <X>` ALSO matches any row whose tiddler carries `<configured-field>: <X>` — Space opens the action menu in tree views (''All tiddlers'', ''By namespace'', etc.) without per-action `ca-applies` filters. Engine ships ''no default'' (opt-in); type-system plugins set it. Installing ''`rimir/kind` ≥ 0.1.50'' presets this to `kind.type` (the universal type-marker stamped on every kind-instance). Raw-edit only.

! Deep-tree search (advanced)

These tune the BFS walker fired by the ''reach'' pills (`R here` / `R everywhere`). All raw-edit only; no settings rows by default — typical users never need to touch them.

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/deep-search-max-depth</code>
:Maximum BFS depth for the deep-search walker. Higher = more thorough, slower. Default 4.

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/deep-search-max-nodes</code>
:Hard cap on total nodes the BFS visits per keystroke. Default 800.

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/deep-search-max-ms</code>
:Time budget per keystroke. The walker bails out when wall-clock exceeds this. Default 80ms.

;<code>$:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/search-fields-default</code>
:Space-separated cascade-item meta keys the matcher scans on each row when no Meta pill is pushed. Default ''`name hint`''. Tiddler-field defaults are not provided — the matcher skips the tiddler-field channel entirely when no Field pill is pushed (keeps the default search cheap).

! Diagnostics

The palette ships a built-in ''Diagnostics'' drill (under ''Configurations''):

* ''Loaded entries'' — every tiddler tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/entry`.
* ''Loaded actions'' — every tiddler tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/action`.
* ''Loaded settings'' — every tiddler tagged `$:/tags/rimir/cascade-palette/setting`.

Use these to verify your authored contributions are visible to the engine. See [[Dev Workflow|$:/plugins/rimir/cascade-palette/doc/dev-workflow]] for the full debugging guide.
"},"$:/plugins/rimir/cascade-palette/styles":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/cascade-palette/styles","tags":"$:/tags/Stylesheet","type":"text/css","text":".rcp-backdrop {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 99999;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: center;
    padding-top: 12vh;
}

.rcp-popup {
    width: min(640px, 90vw);
    max-height: 60vh;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    border: 1px solid #cccccc;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
    display: flex;
    /* Outer layout is flex-row so the side preview pane (when active) sits
       to the right of the cascade. The cascade column owns its own flex-
       column layout internally. */
    flex-direction: row;
    overflow: hidden;
    font: 14px / 1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
}

/* Cascade column — owns the vertical stack of breadcrumb, pill strips,
   input, results, detail drawer, hint, perf footer. When the side preview
   is hidden, it fills the popup; when shown, it shrinks to 50%. */
.rcp-cascade-col {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1 1 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.rcp-popup.rcp-showing-preview .rcp-cascade-col {
    flex: 1 1 50%;
}

/* Side preview pane — right column, hidden by default. Activated by an
   entry/action on the stack carrying `ca-preview-template`. The pane is
   focusable for scrolling / interacting with widgets inside the rendered
   template body. */
.rcp-preview-pane {
    display: none;
    flex: 1 1 50%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-left: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
    background: #fbfaf7;
    outline: none;
}

.rcp-popup.rcp-showing-preview .rcp-preview-pane {
    display: flex;
}

.rcp-preview-pane-pills {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    background: #fbfaf7;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ececec;
    overflow-x: auto;
    user-select: none;
}

.rcp-preview-pane-pills:empty {
    display: none;
    padding: 0;
    border-bottom: none;
}

.rcp-preview-pill {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #555;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.4;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.rcp-preview-pill:hover {
    border-color: #d97706;
    color: #92400e;
}

.rcp-preview-pill-active {
    background: #fef3c7;
    color: #92400e;
    border-color: #fde68a;
}

.rcp-popup[data-focus="preview"] .rcp-preview-pill-active {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #d97706;
}

.rcp-preview-pane-title {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    color: #92400e;
    background: #fef3c7;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #fde68a;
    user-select: none;
}

.rcp-preview-pane-title:empty {
    display: none;
}

.rcp-preview-pane-body {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #1a1a1a;
}

.rcp-popup[data-focus="preview"] .rcp-preview-pane {
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #d97706;
}

/* Filter lab — independent AdvancedSearch-style sandbox rendered into the
   side-preview body while editing a filter facet (cp-side-preview
   _renderFilterLab). Decoupled from the palette input. */
.rcp-filter-lab {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
}

/* "vars in scope" index — collapsible, parked top-right, small font. */
.rcp-filter-lab-vars {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    right: 0;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: #6b7280;
    max-width: 60%;
    z-index: 2;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-vars > summary {
    cursor: pointer;
    list-style: none;
    text-align: right;
    color: #9ca3af;
    user-select: none;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-vars > summary:hover {
    color: #d97706;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-vars-body {
    margin-top: 4px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    background: #f8fafc;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-radius: 4px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}

.rcp-filter-lab-var code {
    font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    color: #b45309;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-var span {
    color: #6b7280;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-hint {
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: #6b7280;
    padding-right: 80px; /* clear the vars-index summary in the corner */
}

.rcp-filter-lab-input-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 6px;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-copy {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 28px;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #f1f5f9;
    color: #475569;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-copy:hover {
    background: #fde9c8;
    border-color: #d97706;
    color: #b45309;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-input {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: #fff;
    color: #1a1a1a;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-input:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: #d97706;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.25);
}

.rcp-filter-lab-count {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #374151;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-row {
    font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    font-size: 12px;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    color: #1f2937;
}

.rcp-filter-lab-row:nth-child(odd) {
    background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12);
}

/* In-palette Help system — side-preview body styling.
   .cp-help-pane is the root element emitted by help/preview-template.tid.
   Kept namespaced under .cp-help-* so it can't collide with other plugin
   preview templates that also render into .rcp-preview-pane-body. */
.cp-help-pane {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.45;
    color: #1f2937;
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 8px;
    padding-bottom: 6px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-icon {
    font-size: 18px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-title {
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #111827;
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-summary {
    color: #6b7280;
    font-style: italic;
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-body {
    /* Inherit table styling from the TW theme; just tighten spacing. */
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-body table {
    border-collapse: collapse;
    margin: 6px 0;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-body th,
.cp-help-pane .cp-help-body td {
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    text-align: left;
    vertical-align: top;
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-body th {
    background: #f9fafb;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-body code {
    font-size: 11.5px;
    padding: 1px 4px;
    background: #f3f4f6;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-body pre {
    font-size: 11.5px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    background: #f3f4f6;
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow-x: auto;
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-body h1 {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin: 10px 0 4px;
    color: #1f2937;
}

.cp-help-pane .cp-help-see-also {
    margin-top: 6px;
    padding-top: 6px;
    border-top: 1px dashed #d1d5db;
    color: #6b7280;
    font-size: 12px;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .cp-help-pane {
        color: #d1d5db;
    }
    .cp-help-pane .cp-help-head {
        border-bottom-color: #374151;
    }
    .cp-help-pane .cp-help-title {
        color: #f9fafb;
    }
    .cp-help-pane .cp-help-summary {
        color: #9ca3af;
    }
    .cp-help-pane .cp-help-body th,
    .cp-help-pane .cp-help-body td {
        border-color: #374151;
    }
    .cp-help-pane .cp-help-body th {
        background: #1f2937;
    }
    .cp-help-pane .cp-help-body code,
    .cp-help-pane .cp-help-body pre {
        background: #1f2937;
        color: #e5e7eb;
    }
    .cp-help-pane .cp-help-body h1 {
        color: #f3f4f6;
    }
    .cp-help-pane .cp-help-see-also {
        border-top-color: #374151;
        color: #9ca3af;
    }
}

.rcp-breadcrumb {
    padding: 8px 14px;
    background: #f4f5f7;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #5a5a5a;
    user-select: none;
}

.rcp-breadcrumb-seg.rcp-breadcrumb-clickable {
    cursor: pointer;
    color: #1769aa;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.rcp-breadcrumb-seg.rcp-breadcrumb-clickable:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}

.rcp-breadcrumb-sep {
    margin: 0 4px;
    color: #a0a0a0;
}

/* View strip — thin row of pills naming each registered view. Hidden
   when fewer than two views are declared (single-view setups don't need
   selectability — `.rcp-has-views` toggles `display: flex`). The active
   view's pill is visually distinct; the keyboard-focused pill (while
   focus === "view") gets the focus ring. */
.rcp-view-strip {
    display: none;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    background: #fafaf7;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    outline: none;
}

.rcp-popup.rcp-has-views .rcp-view-strip {
    display: flex;
}

.rcp-popup[data-focus="view"] .rcp-view-strip {
    background: #fef3c7;
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #d97706;
}

.rcp-view-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 2px 10px;
    background: #f3f4f6;
    color: #1f2937;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
}

.rcp-view-pill:hover {
    background: #e5e7eb;
}

.rcp-view-pill-active {
    background: #fde68a;
    color: #78350f;
    border-color: #d97706;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.rcp-view-pill-focused {
    background: #fbbf24;
    border-color: #b45309;
    color: #451a03;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.35);
}

/* View-pill context-aware badge — small dot appended via ::after when
   the view declares ca-view-context-aware: yes AND sticky context is
   non-empty. Signals "this view will specialize for the pinned set"
   without claiming anything about how (that lives in the layer
   filters). Indigo to match the context strip accent. */
.rcp-view-pill-context-aware::after {
    content: "";
    display: inline-block;
    margin-left: 6px;
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #4f46e5;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

/* (The standalone lens slot strips were removed in 0.0.118 — the choosers
   moved into the view→channel tree, styled as .rcp-view-config-pill-lens
   below.) */

/* View-config strip — read-only stacked layout depicting the active
   view's structure. The strip is a column of mini-rows, one per layer
   (plus a view-scoped header row). Each mini-row carries its own label
   on the left and a horizontal pill list on the right. Subdued styling
   distinguishes it from the actionable strips above. Hidden via
   `rcp-has-view-config` when no layers / no pills apply. */
.rcp-view-config-strip {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 3px;
    padding: 5px 14px 6px;
    background: #fafaf9;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ececec;
    outline: none;
}

.rcp-view-config-strip-focused {
    background: #f3f6ff;
    border-bottom-color: #b6c5ff;
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #4338ca;
}

.rcp-view-config-row-compact {
    align-items: center;
}

.rcp-view-config-pill-summary .rcp-view-config-pill-label,
.rcp-view-config-pill-summary-layers .rcp-view-config-pill-label { color: #2563eb; }

.rcp-view-config-pill-focused {
    background: #dbeafe;
    border-color: #6366f1;
    color: #1e3a8a;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #6366f1;
}

.rcp-view-config-pill-focused .rcp-view-config-pill-value {
    color: #1e3a8a;
}

.rcp-popup.rcp-has-view-config .rcp-view-config-strip {
    display: flex;
}

.rcp-view-config-strip::before {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-self: flex-start;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    color: #9ca3af;
    user-select: none;
    pointer-events: none;
    content: "Structure";
    margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.rcp-view-config-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

.rcp-view-config-row::-webkit-scrollbar {
    height: 4px;
}
.rcp-view-config-row::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
}
.rcp-view-config-row::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #c5d2ff;
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.rcp-view-config-row-builtin {
    opacity: 0.78;
}

.rcp-view-config-row-label {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    min-width: 80px;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: #6b7280;
    padding-right: 6px;
    user-select: none;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.rcp-view-config-row-view .rcp-view-config-row-label {
    color: #9ca3af;
    font-style: italic;
}

.rcp-view-config-row-builtin .rcp-view-config-row-label {
    color: #9ca3af;
}

/* Channel rows indent under the VIEW row so the view→channel tree reads as a
   two-level hierarchy (the view header is the parent; each channel a child). */
.rcp-view-config-row-layer {
    padding-left: 14px;
    border-left: 2px solid #e5e7eb;
    margin-left: 4px;
}

/* Lens-slot choosers. An inherited (or off) channel slot is dimmed — its value
   is not authored on the channel; a locked slot reads as fixed by the view. */
.rcp-view-config-pill-lens .rcp-view-config-pill-label {
    color: #7c3aed;
}
.rcp-view-config-pill-inherited {
    opacity: 0.6;
    font-style: italic;
}
.rcp-view-config-pill-locked {
    border-style: dashed;
}

.rcp-view-config-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 1px 8px;
    background: #f3f4f6;
    color: #4b5563;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    user-select: none;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.rcp-view-config-pill-label {
    color: #9ca3af;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.rcp-view-config-pill-value {
    white-space: nowrap;
    color: #374151;
}

.rcp-view-config-pill-roots .rcp-view-config-pill-label       { color: #2563eb; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-children .rcp-view-config-pill-label    { color: #047857; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-leaf .rcp-view-config-pill-label        { color: #b45309; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-label .rcp-view-config-pill-label       { color: #6b7280; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-actions .rcp-view-config-pill-label     { color: #7c3aed; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-entity-type .rcp-view-config-pill-label { color: #db2777; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-row-name .rcp-view-config-pill-label,
.rcp-view-config-pill-row-group .rcp-view-config-pill-label,
.rcp-view-config-pill-row-kind .rcp-view-config-pill-label    { color: #6b7280; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-sort .rcp-view-config-pill-label        { color: #475569; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-pick .rcp-view-config-pill-label        { color: #be185d; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-entries-mode .rcp-view-config-pill-label { color: #6b7280; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-grouping .rcp-view-config-pill-label    { color: #475569; }
/* Structure-toggle pills (boolean on/off switches, e.g. kind's "Kind
   icons"). Indigo label marks them as interactive switches; the ☑/☐
   value glyph carries the on/off state. */
.rcp-view-config-pill-struct-toggle .rcp-view-config-pill-label { color: #4f46e5; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-struct-toggle .rcp-view-config-pill-value { font-size: 1.05em; }

/* Axis pills — derived/computed dimension, distinct hue from declarative
   pills above. The label colour deliberately reads as accent-on-cream, so
   chained "by → → →" axis pills cluster visually together. */
.rcp-view-config-pill-axis {
    background: #fdf4e3;
    border-color: #facc15;
}
.rcp-view-config-pill-axis .rcp-view-config-pill-label  { color: #b45309; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-axis .rcp-view-config-pill-value  { color: #78350f; }

.rcp-view-config-pill-axis-add {
    background: #f8fafc;
    border-style: dashed;
    border-color: #cbd5e1;
    color: #94a3b8;
}
.rcp-view-config-pill-axis-add .rcp-view-config-pill-label {
    color: #475569;
    font-size: 11px;
}
.rcp-view-config-pill-axis-add .rcp-view-config-pill-value {
    color: #94a3b8;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* Editable facet pills — a subtle dotted underline on the value hints that
   Enter edits it in place (raw filter / cycle / flip). The focused-pill
   highlight (above) still carries the primary affordance. */
.rcp-view-config-pill-editable .rcp-view-config-pill-value {
    border-bottom: 1px dotted #9ca3af;
}

/* Scratchpad commit pills — lead the Structure header row while editing a
   working copy. Green = save-as-new, amber = overwrite (touches consumers),
   red = discard. */
.rcp-view-config-pill-commit {
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.rcp-view-config-pill-commit-save-new  { background: #ecfdf5; border-color: #6ee7b7; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-commit-save-new .rcp-view-config-pill-label  { color: #047857; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-commit-overwrite { background: #fffbeb; border-color: #fcd34d; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-commit-overwrite .rcp-view-config-pill-label { color: #b45309; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-commit-discard   { background: #fef2f2; border-color: #fca5a5; }
.rcp-view-config-pill-commit-discard .rcp-view-config-pill-label   { color: #b91c1c; }

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-view-config-strip {
        background: #181d24;
        border-bottom-color: #2a2f38;
    }
    .rcp-view-config-row::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: #4338ca;
    }
    .rcp-view-config-strip-focused {
        background: #1e2438;
        border-bottom-color: #4338ca;
        box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #818cf8;
    }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-focused {
        background: #312e81;
        border-color: #818cf8;
        color: #e0e7ff;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #818cf8;
    }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-focused .rcp-view-config-pill-value {
        color: #e0e7ff;
    }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-summary .rcp-view-config-pill-label,
    .rcp-view-config-pill-summary-layers .rcp-view-config-pill-label { color: #93c5fd; }
    .rcp-view-config-strip::before {
        color: #6b7280;
    }
    .rcp-view-config-pill {
        background: #1f2937;
        color: #d1d5db;
        border-color: #374151;
    }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-value {
        color: #e5e7eb;
    }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-roots .rcp-view-config-pill-label       { color: #60a5fa; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-children .rcp-view-config-pill-label    { color: #34d399; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-leaf .rcp-view-config-pill-label        { color: #fbbf24; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-actions .rcp-view-config-pill-label     { color: #c4b5fd; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-entity-type .rcp-view-config-pill-label { color: #f9a8d4; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-row-name .rcp-view-config-pill-label,
    .rcp-view-config-pill-row-group .rcp-view-config-pill-label,
    .rcp-view-config-pill-row-kind .rcp-view-config-pill-label    { color: #9ca3af; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-sort .rcp-view-config-pill-label        { color: #94a3b8; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-pick .rcp-view-config-pill-label        { color: #f472b6; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-entries-mode .rcp-view-config-pill-label { color: #9ca3af; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-grouping .rcp-view-config-pill-label    { color: #94a3b8; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-axis {
        background: #422006;
        border-color: #ca8a04;
    }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-axis .rcp-view-config-pill-label  { color: #fbbf24; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-axis .rcp-view-config-pill-value  { color: #fde68a; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-axis-add {
        background: #1f2937;
        border-color: #475569;
    }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-axis-add .rcp-view-config-pill-label { color: #cbd5e1; }
    .rcp-view-config-pill-axis-add .rcp-view-config-pill-value { color: #64748b; }
    .rcp-view-config-row-label                                     { color: #9ca3af; }
    .rcp-view-config-row-view .rcp-view-config-row-label,
    .rcp-view-config-row-builtin .rcp-view-config-row-label        { color: #6b7280; }
}

/* Container count badge — small dimmed digit after the segment name on
   tree-view container rows when the view declares show-count. */
.rcp-row-count {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #6b7280;
    margin-left: 2px;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.rcp-popup[data-focus="menu"] .rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-count {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
}

.rcp-row-action-preview {
    margin-left: 6px;
    padding: 1px 6px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #eef2ff;
    color: #4338ca;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    user-select: none;
}

.rcp-popup[data-focus="menu"] .rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-action-preview {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
    color: #e0e7ff;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-row-action-preview {
        background: #1e1b4b;
        color: #c7d2fe;
    }
}

/* Annotation slot (augment-trail) — a trailing chip after the row name,
   supplied by the active annotation lens (H4). Filter projections fill it
   with a plain string ("🏖 until Jun 20"); template projections (.rich)
   fill it with inline markup. Amber tone keeps it distinct from the indigo
   action-preview badge on the right. */
.rcp-row-annotation {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    margin-left: 6px;
    padding: 1px 7px;
    border-radius: 9px;
    background: #fef3c7;
    color: #92400e;
    font-size: 11px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    user-select: none;
}
.rcp-row-annotation-rich {
    padding: 0 4px;
    background: transparent;
}
/* Inline pills emitted by the shipped "Tags" template annotation lens. */
.rcp-row-anno-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-right: 3px;
    padding: 0 6px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #fde68a;
    color: #78350f;
    font-size: 10px;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-row-anno-tag {
        background: #4a2c08;
        color: #fcd34d;
    }
}
.rcp-popup[data-focus="menu"] .rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-annotation {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
    color: #fffbeb;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-row-annotation {
        background: #422006;
        color: #fcd34d;
    }
}

/* Left-edge marker on rows whose action-discovery returned a non-empty
   set. Mirrors what the right-side ".rcp-row-action-preview" badge
   communicates, but at the leading edge of the row so the user can
   scan ↑/↓ and spot actionable rows at a glance. Stamped by
   _maybeAppendActionPreview after it confirms count > 0. */
.rcp-row-actionable {
    box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #6366f1;
}
.rcp-row-selected.rcp-row-actionable {
    box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #c7d2fe;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-row-actionable {
        box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #818cf8;
    }
    .rcp-row-selected.rcp-row-actionable {
        box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #eef2ff;
    }
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-view-strip {
        background: #1f1d18;
        border-bottom-color: #374151;
    }
    .rcp-popup[data-focus="view"] .rcp-view-strip {
        background: #78350f;
    }
    .rcp-view-pill {
        background: #2d2a23;
        color: #f3f4f6;
        border-color: #4b3a1f;
    }
    .rcp-view-pill:hover {
        background: #3d3829;
    }
    .rcp-view-pill-active {
        background: #92400e;
        color: #fef3c7;
        border-color: #fbbf24;
    }
    .rcp-view-pill-focused {
        background: #b45309;
        border-color: #fde68a;
        color: #fef3c7;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.45);
    }
}

/* Preset strip — thin row of pills, one per saved preset. Sits above
   the view strip. Pills do NOT wrap (`flex-wrap: nowrap`); on overflow
   the strip scrolls horizontally and keyboard navigation calls
   `scrollIntoView` on the focused pill. Pink/rose accent distinguishes
   presets from view (amber), filter (blue) and visibility (orange). */
.rcp-preset-strip {
    display: none;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    overflow-x: auto;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    background: #fdf2f8;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    outline: none;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

.rcp-preset-strip::-webkit-scrollbar {
    height: 4px;
}
.rcp-preset-strip::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
}
.rcp-preset-strip::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #f9a8d4;
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.rcp-popup.rcp-has-presets .rcp-preset-strip {
    display: flex;
}

.rcp-popup[data-focus="preset"] .rcp-preset-strip {
    background: #fce7f3;
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #be185d;
}

.rcp-preset-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 2px 10px;
    background: #fce7f3;
    color: #831843;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 1px solid #fbcfe8;
}

.rcp-preset-pill:hover {
    background: #fbcfe8;
}

.rcp-preset-pill-focused {
    background: #f9a8d4;
    border-color: #be185d;
    color: #500724;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(190, 24, 93, 0.35);
}

/* Active preset — currently loaded. Heavier border to stand out from
   the surrounding pills regardless of focus. */
.rcp-preset-pill-active {
    border-color: #be185d;
    border-width: 2px;
    padding: 1px 9px; /* compensate for thicker border */
    font-weight: 600;
}

/* Active + dirty — user has edited filters / visibility / view since
   the preset was loaded. Distinct accent so the user notices the
   pending overwrite opportunity. The trailing " *" in the label is the
   text-only fallback. */
.rcp-preset-pill-dirty {
    background: #fef3c7;
    color: #78350f;
    border-color: #d97706;
}

.rcp-preset-pill-dirty:hover {
    background: #fde68a;
}

.rcp-preset-pill-active.rcp-preset-pill-focused {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(190, 24, 93, 0.55);
}

.rcp-preset-pill-dirty.rcp-preset-pill-focused {
    background: #fde68a;
    border-color: #b45309;
    color: #451a03;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.45);
}

/* Trailing "+" save pill — visually distinct from real presets so the
   user can immediately tell it's an action affordance, not a saved
   bundle. Dashed border + neutral grey palette + bolder glyph. */
.rcp-preset-pill-plus {
    background: transparent;
    color: #6b7280;
    border-style: dashed;
    border-color: #d1d5db;
    font-weight: 700;
    min-width: 18px;
    justify-content: center;
}

.rcp-preset-pill-plus:hover {
    background: #f3f4f6;
    border-color: #9ca3af;
    color: #374151;
}

.rcp-preset-pill-plus.rcp-preset-pill-focused {
    background: #e5e7eb;
    border-color: #6b7280;
    color: #1f2937;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(107, 114, 128, 0.45);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-preset-strip {
        background: #1f1825;
        border-bottom-color: #374151;
    }
    .rcp-preset-strip::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: #be185d;
    }
    .rcp-popup[data-focus="preset"] .rcp-preset-strip {
        background: #500724;
    }
    .rcp-preset-pill {
        background: #2b1d24;
        color: #fce7f3;
        border-color: #6b1839;
    }
    .rcp-preset-pill:hover {
        background: #3d2530;
    }
    .rcp-preset-pill-focused {
        background: #9d174d;
        border-color: #fbcfe8;
        color: #fdf2f8;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.45);
    }
    .rcp-preset-pill-active {
        border-color: #fbcfe8;
    }
    .rcp-preset-pill-dirty {
        background: #422a18;
        color: #fef3c7;
        border-color: #d97706;
    }
    .rcp-preset-pill-dirty:hover {
        background: #5a3a22;
    }
    .rcp-preset-pill-dirty.rcp-preset-pill-focused {
        background: #78350f;
        border-color: #fde68a;
        color: #fffbeb;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.55);
    }
    .rcp-preset-pill-plus {
        background: transparent;
        color: #9ca3af;
        border-color: #4b5563;
    }
    .rcp-preset-pill-plus:hover {
        background: #1f2937;
        border-color: #9ca3af;
        color: #f3f4f6;
    }
    .rcp-preset-pill-plus.rcp-preset-pill-focused {
        background: #374151;
        border-color: #d1d5db;
        color: #f9fafb;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(156, 163, 175, 0.55);
    }
}

/* Strip labels — small dimmed uppercase prefix in front of each pill row
   so the user knows at a glance what kind of strip they're on. Rendered
   as `::before` so no JS changes are needed. `flex-shrink: 0` keeps the
   label from collapsing when many pills crowd the row; `min-width`
   forces all three labels to occupy the same horizontal column so each
   strip's first pill lines up under the next strip's first pill. The
   preset label is `position: sticky; left: 0` so it stays visible while
   pills scroll horizontally past it — opaque background masks pills
   passing underneath; the focused-strip tint carries through. */
.rcp-preset-strip::before,
.rcp-context-strip::before,
.rcp-visibility-strip::before,
.rcp-filter-strip::before,
.rcp-view-strip::before,
.rcp-reach-strip::before,
.rcp-meta-strip::before,
.rcp-field-strip::before,
.rcp-leader-strip::before {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-self: center;
    min-width: 56px;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    color: #9ca3af;
    padding-right: 8px;
    user-select: none;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.rcp-preset-strip::before {
    content: "Presets";
    position: sticky;
    left: 0;
    background: #fdf2f8;
    z-index: 1;
}

.rcp-popup[data-focus="preset"] .rcp-preset-strip::before {
    background: #fce7f3;
}

.rcp-context-strip::before    { content: "Context"; }
.rcp-visibility-strip::before { content: "Visibility"; }
.rcp-filter-strip::before     { content: "Filters"; }
.rcp-view-strip::before       { content: "Views"; }
.rcp-reach-strip::before      { content: "Reach"; }
.rcp-meta-strip::before       { content: "⌕ Meta"; }
.rcp-field-strip::before      { content: "⌕ Field"; }

.rcp-leader-strip::before {
    content: "Leaders";
    position: sticky;
    left: 0;
    background: #faf5ff;
    z-index: 1;
}

.rcp-popup[data-focus="leader"] .rcp-leader-strip::before {
    background: #ede9fe;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-preset-strip::before,
    .rcp-context-strip::before,
    .rcp-visibility-strip::before,
    .rcp-filter-strip::before,
    .rcp-view-strip::before,
    .rcp-reach-strip::before,
    .rcp-meta-strip::before,
    .rcp-field-strip::before,
    .rcp-leader-strip::before {
        color: #6b7280;
    }
    .rcp-preset-strip::before {
        background: #1f1825;
    }
    .rcp-popup[data-focus="preset"] .rcp-preset-strip::before {
        background: #500724;
    }
    .rcp-leader-strip::before {
        background: #1e1929;
    }
    .rcp-popup[data-focus="leader"] .rcp-leader-strip::before {
        background: #2e1065;
    }
    .rcp-reach-strip {
        background: #042f2e;
        border-bottom-color: #374151;
    }
    .rcp-popup[data-focus="reach"] .rcp-reach-strip {
        background: #0e7490;
    }
    .rcp-reach-strip .rcp-pill-focused {
        background: #155e75;
        border-color: #67e8f9;
        color: #cffafe;
    }
    .rcp-meta-strip {
        background: #1e1b3a;
        border-bottom-color: #374151;
    }
    .rcp-popup[data-focus="meta"] .rcp-meta-strip {
        background: #4c1d95;
    }
    .rcp-meta-strip .rcp-pill-focused {
        background: #5b21b6;
        border-color: #c4b5fd;
        color: #ede9fe;
    }
    .rcp-field-strip {
        background: #3a2e0a;
        border-bottom-color: #374151;
    }
    .rcp-popup[data-focus="field"] .rcp-field-strip {
        background: #92400e;
    }
    .rcp-field-strip .rcp-pill-focused {
        background: #b45309;
        border-color: #fcd34d;
        color: #fef3c7;
    }
}

/* Filter strip — pills that intersect every stage's data filter.
   Sits below the visibility strip. Blue accent. Hidden when no filters
   are active (the popup picks up `.rcp-has-filters` only when at least
   one pill is present). The strip stays in the DOM so focus mechanics
   work cleanly during transitions. */
.rcp-filter-strip,
.rcp-context-strip,
.rcp-visibility-strip,
.rcp-reach-strip,
.rcp-meta-strip,
.rcp-field-strip {
    display: none;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    outline: none;
}

/* Sticky-context strip — session-persistent pinned tiddler titles
   exposed to context-aware views as <<sticky-context-list>>. Indigo
   accent distinguishes it from the constraint family (filter blue /
   visibility red / reach teal). Sits between preset and visibility. */
.rcp-context-strip {
    background: #eef2ff;
}
.rcp-popup.rcp-has-context .rcp-context-strip {
    display: flex;
}
.rcp-popup[data-focus="context"] .rcp-context-strip {
    background: #e0e7ff;
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #4338ca;
}

/* Stale pin — the referenced tiddler no longer exists. Greyed text,
   strike-through to communicate the broken reference without removing
   it (user clears explicitly via ×/Backspace). */
.rcp-context-strip .rcp-pill-stale {
    background: #f3f4f6;
    color: #9ca3af;
    border-color: #d1d5db;
    text-decoration: line-through;
}

.rcp-context-strip .rcp-pill-focused {
    background: #c7d2fe;
    border-color: #4338ca;
    color: #312e81;
}

/* Reach strip — pills that decide WHERE in the cascade tree the search
   walks. Sits above the filter strip in the visual stack. Teal accent
   distinguishes it from filters (blue) / visibility (orange/red).
   Hidden when no reach pills are pushed. */
.rcp-reach-strip {
    background: #ecfeff;
}
.rcp-popup.rcp-has-reach .rcp-reach-strip {
    display: flex;
}
.rcp-popup[data-focus="reach"] .rcp-reach-strip {
    background: #cffafe;
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #0e7490;
}

/* Meta strip — pills that decide WHICH cascade-item author meta keys
   the matcher reads (name / hint / description / aliases /
   searchText). Sits next to the reach strip. Violet accent. Hidden
   when no meta pills are pushed. */
.rcp-meta-strip {
    background: #f5f3ff;
}
.rcp-popup.rcp-has-meta .rcp-meta-strip {
    display: flex;
}
.rcp-popup[data-focus="meta"] .rcp-meta-strip {
    background: #ede9fe;
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #6d28d9;
}

/* Field strip — pills that decide WHICH literal tiddler fields the
   matcher reads on the row's backing tiddler (text / caption / tags /
   author-defined). Amber accent distinguishes it from the violet meta
   strip. Hidden when no field pills are pushed. */
.rcp-field-strip {
    background: #fffbeb;
}
.rcp-popup.rcp-has-field .rcp-field-strip {
    display: flex;
}
.rcp-popup[data-focus="field"] .rcp-field-strip {
    background: #fef3c7;
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #b45309;
}

/* Pin-all-pill-rows — settings toggle bound to
   $:/config/rimir/cascade-palette/pin-pill-rows. When `yes`, the popup
   picks up `rcp-pin-pill-rows` and every pill strip renders even when
   no pills are pushed. Useful as a dev/discoverability aid. */
.rcp-popup.rcp-pin-pill-rows .rcp-context-strip,
.rcp-popup.rcp-pin-pill-rows .rcp-visibility-strip,
.rcp-popup.rcp-pin-pill-rows .rcp-reach-strip,
.rcp-popup.rcp-pin-pill-rows .rcp-meta-strip,
.rcp-popup.rcp-pin-pill-rows .rcp-field-strip,
.rcp-popup.rcp-pin-pill-rows .rcp-filter-strip {
    display: flex;
}

/* Pill-focused colours per strip — overrides the default blue ring
   so each strip's accent reads through to its focused pill. */
.rcp-reach-strip .rcp-pill-focused {
    background: #a5f3fc;
    border-color: #0e7490;
    color: #134e4a;
}
.rcp-meta-strip .rcp-pill-focused {
    background: #ddd6fe;
    border-color: #6d28d9;
    color: #2e1065;
}
.rcp-field-strip .rcp-pill-focused {
    background: #fde68a;
    border-color: #b45309;
    color: #78350f;
}

.rcp-filter-strip {
    background: #f9fafb;
}
.rcp-popup.rcp-has-filters .rcp-filter-strip {
    display: flex;
}
.rcp-popup[data-focus="filter"] .rcp-filter-strip {
    background: #eff6ff;
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #2563eb;
}

/* Visibility strip — pills that hide root entries via predicate filter.
   Red/orange accent communicates "removal". Hidden when no visibility
   rules are active. */
.rcp-visibility-strip {
    background: #fef3f0;
}
.rcp-popup.rcp-has-visibility .rcp-visibility-strip {
    display: flex;
}
.rcp-popup[data-focus="visibility"] .rcp-visibility-strip {
    background: #fee2db;
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #c2410c;
}

/* Pill — shared shell. The focused-class colour is overridden per
   strip below to match the strip's accent. */
.rcp-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    background: #e5e7eb;
    color: #1f2937;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.rcp-pill:hover {
    background: #d1d5db;
}

/* Default focused-pill (used by filter strip — blue). */
.rcp-pill-focused {
    background: #bfdbfe;
    border-color: #2563eb;
    color: #1e3a8a;
}

/* Override: visibility strip's focused-pill is orange/red. */
.rcp-visibility-strip .rcp-pill-focused {
    background: #fed7aa;
    border-color: #c2410c;
    color: #7c2d12;
}

.rcp-pill-remove {
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1;
    opacity: 0.55;
    padding: 0 2px;
    margin-left: 2px;
}

.rcp-pill:hover .rcp-pill-remove {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Input cue when the current text matches a filter prefix — blue
   underline + the hint footer changes to "↵ commit filter: …". */
.rcp-input.rcp-input-filter-match {
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #2563eb;
    border-bottom-color: #2563eb;
}

/* Input cue when the current text matches a visibility prefix — orange
   underline + "↵ commit visibility: …". */
.rcp-input.rcp-input-visibility-match {
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #c2410c;
    border-bottom-color: #c2410c;
}

/* Input cue when the current text matches a leader key — amber under-
   line, distinct from filter/visibility tints. The 200ms idle window
   commits the leader automatically; a further keystroke cancels. */
.rcp-input.rcp-input-leader-match {
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #d97706;
    border-bottom-color: #d97706;
    background: #fffbeb;
}

/* Input cue when the current text matches the sticky-context "+" prefix.
   Indigo underline + "↵ pin to context: …" in the footer. Enter pins
   the typed title verbatim (no autocomplete — use Space-pin on a
   menu row for that). */
.rcp-input.rcp-input-context-match {
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #4f46e5;
    border-bottom-color: #4f46e5;
}

/* Pill flash — brief amber pulse on a view/filter/visibility pill when
   a leader action just changed it. Pure perceptual reinforcement that
   the leader did something; no functional dependency. */
@keyframes rcp-pill-flash {
    0%   { background: #fde68a; }
    50%  { background: #fbbf24; }
    100% { background: inherit; }
}

.rcp-pill-flash {
    animation: rcp-pill-flash 380ms ease-out;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-filter-strip {
        background: #111827;
        border-bottom-color: #374151;
    }
    .rcp-popup[data-focus="filter"] .rcp-filter-strip {
        background: #1e3a8a;
    }
    .rcp-context-strip {
        background: #1e1b3a;
        border-bottom-color: #374151;
    }
    .rcp-popup[data-focus="context"] .rcp-context-strip {
        background: #3730a3;
    }
    .rcp-context-strip .rcp-pill-focused {
        background: #3730a3;
        border-color: #a5b4fc;
        color: #e0e7ff;
    }
    .rcp-context-strip .rcp-pill-stale {
        background: #1f2937;
        color: #6b7280;
        border-color: #374151;
    }
    .rcp-visibility-strip {
        background: #1c1411;
        border-bottom-color: #374151;
    }
    .rcp-popup[data-focus="visibility"] .rcp-visibility-strip {
        background: #7c2d12;
    }
    .rcp-pill {
        background: #374151;
        color: #f3f4f6;
    }
    .rcp-pill:hover {
        background: #4b5563;
    }
    .rcp-pill-focused {
        background: #1e40af;
        border-color: #60a5fa;
        color: #dbeafe;
    }
    .rcp-visibility-strip .rcp-pill-focused {
        background: #9a3412;
        border-color: #fdba74;
        color: #fed7aa;
    }
    .rcp-input.rcp-input-filter-match {
        box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #60a5fa;
        border-bottom-color: #60a5fa;
    }
    .rcp-input.rcp-input-visibility-match {
        box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #fdba74;
        border-bottom-color: #fdba74;
    }
    .rcp-input.rcp-input-leader-match {
        box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #fbbf24;
        border-bottom-color: #fbbf24;
        background: #1f1d18;
    }
    .rcp-input.rcp-input-context-match {
        box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #a5b4fc;
        border-bottom-color: #a5b4fc;
    }
    @keyframes rcp-pill-flash {
        0%   { background: #92400e; }
        50%  { background: #fbbf24; }
        100% { background: inherit; }
    }
}

.rcp-input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    border: 0;
    outline: 0;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.rcp-results {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 4px 0;
    margin: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
    background: #ffffff;
}

.rcp-row {
    padding: 8px 14px;
    cursor: default;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    user-select: none;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    border-left: 3px solid transparent;
}

/* Selected row, with focus-state differentiation. When focus is in the
   input, the selection is "warm" (faded). When focus is in the menu,
   it's "active" (strong blue). When in details, it's faded but tinted
   to remind the user the menu still owns selection. */
.rcp-row-selected {
    background: #c7d2fe;
    color: #1e3a8a;
    border-left-color: #6366f1;
}
.rcp-popup[data-focus="menu"] .rcp-row-selected {
    background: #2563eb;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-left-color: #1e40af;
}
.rcp-popup[data-focus="details"] .rcp-row-selected {
    background: #dbeafe;
    color: #1e3a8a;
    border-left-color: #93c5fd;
}

/* Section focus rings — only the input keeps its native ring; results
   and details get a subtle border-color shift instead so the popup
   doesn't accumulate strong outlines. */
.rcp-results:focus,
.rcp-detail-drawer:focus {
    outline: none;
}
.rcp-popup[data-focus="menu"] .rcp-results {
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #2563eb;
}
.rcp-popup[data-focus="details"] .rcp-detail-drawer{
    box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #2563eb;
}

.rcp-row-name {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Deep-search breadcrumb prefix — sits between icon and name, naming
   the drill chain from search anchor to the matched row. Muted so the
   row's own name remains the visual lead. Same colour family as the
   top breadcrumb (.rcp-breadcrumb) for consistency. */
.rcp-row-breadcrumb {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #6b7280;
    user-select: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
    max-width: 50%;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.rcp-row-breadcrumb-seg {
    color: #4b5563;
}

.rcp-row-breadcrumb-sep {
    margin: 0 2px;
    color: #9ca3af;
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-breadcrumb,
.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-breadcrumb-seg {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-breadcrumb-sep {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
}

/* Match highlight wrap — applied to the matched substring inside the
   row name / hint / snippet. Uses the cascade-palette accent (blue) so
   it harmonises with the existing focus rings and pill colours. */
.rcp-match {
    background: #fef3c7;
    color: #78350f;
    border-radius: 2px;
    padding: 0 2px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-match {
    background: rgba(254, 243, 199, 0.45);
    color: #fef9c3;
}

/* Snippet line shown beneath the row when the match lives in a field
   that isn't rendered inline (description / aliases / searchText / a
   custom search field). The row container wraps via the sibling
   .rcp-row-has-snippet class so the snippet drops to its own line. */
.rcp-row-has-snippet {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.rcp-row-snippet {
    flex: 0 0 100%;
    margin-top: 2px;
    margin-left: calc(1.4em + 10px);  /* align with row name (icon + gap) */
    font-size: 11px;
    font-style: italic;
    color: #6b7280;
    line-height: 1.35;
    word-break: break-word;
    white-space: normal;
}

.rcp-row-snippet-field {
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #4b5563;
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-right: 2px;
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-snippet,
.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-snippet-field {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}

/* Truncation sentinel — appears at the end of a deep-search result
   list when caps fired. Italic + muted + non-interactive cue. */
.rcp-row-deep-truncated {
    color: #9ca3af;
    font-style: italic;
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

.rcp-row-deep-truncated .rcp-row-name {
    color: #9ca3af;
}

/* Ancestor-only marker — in tree-container views, parents revealed
   purely because a descendant matched the active filter pills render
   dimmed. Tells the user "drill in to find the real hit" without
   making them wonder why this row doesn't appear to match. The selected
   row keeps full contrast so the user can read its title even when
   navigating through ancestors. */
.rcp-row-ancestor-only .rcp-row-name {
    opacity: 0.55;
    font-style: italic;
}
.rcp-row-ancestor-only.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-name {
    opacity: 1;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-row-breadcrumb,
    .rcp-row-breadcrumb-seg {
        color: #9ca3af;
    }
    .rcp-row-breadcrumb-sep {
        color: #6b7280;
    }
    .rcp-match {
        background: #78350f;
        color: #fef3c7;
    }
    .rcp-row-selected .rcp-match {
        background: rgba(120, 53, 15, 0.65);
        color: #fef9c3;
    }
    .rcp-row-snippet,
    .rcp-row-snippet-field {
        color: #9ca3af;
    }
    .rcp-row-snippet-field {
        color: #d1d5db;
    }
    .rcp-row-deep-truncated,
    .rcp-row-deep-truncated .rcp-row-name {
        color: #6b7280;
    }
    .rcp-row-ancestor-only .rcp-row-name {
        opacity: 0.5;
        font-style: italic;
    }
    .rcp-row-ancestor-only.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-name {
        opacity: 1;
    }
}

.rcp-row-hint {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #6b7280;
}

.rcp-row-title {
    flex: 0 1 45%;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-align: right;
    color: #9ca3af;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    direction: rtl;
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-title {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-row-title {
        color: #6b7280;
    }
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-hint {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}

.rcp-row-icon {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 1.4em;
    text-align: center;
}

/* Row-icon footer strip — surfaces affordances on the row's backing
   tiddler (URLs etc.) as small glyphs below the main line. Container is
   appended only when at least one icon resolves, so there is no empty-
   strip case to suppress. */
.rcp-row-has-icons {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.rcp-row-icons {
    flex: 0 0 100%;
    display: flex;
    gap: 3px;
    /* Row uses flex `gap: 10px` between items, which applies between the
       wrapped name line and this strip too — pull the strip up to cancel
       the gap and tuck it under the title. */
    margin-top: -8px;
    margin-left: calc(1.4em + 10px);  /* align with row name (icon + gap) */
    font-size: 6px;
    line-height: 1;
}

.rcp-row-icon-glyph {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 1.2em;
    padding: 0 1px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    color: #6b7280;
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    transition: color 0.12s ease, background 0.12s ease;
}

.rcp-row-icon-glyph:hover {
    color: #2563eb;
    background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08);
}

.rcp-row-icon-glyph-primary {
    color: #4b5563;
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-icon-glyph {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-icon-glyph:hover {
    color: #ffffff;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-row-icon-glyph {
        color: #9ca3af;
    }
    .rcp-row-icon-glyph:hover {
        color: #93c5fd;
        background: rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.12);
    }
    .rcp-row-icon-glyph-primary {
        color: #d1d5db;
    }
}

.rcp-row-checkbox {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 1.4em;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #6b7280;
}

.rcp-row-checkbox-on {
    color: #2563eb;
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-checkbox,
.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-checkbox-on {
    color: #ffffff;
}

.rcp-row-value {
    flex: 0 1 auto;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    text-align: right;
    color: #6b7280;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}

.rcp-row-slider {
    flex: 0 0 120px;
    height: 4px;
    background: #e5e7eb;
    border-radius: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
    align-self: center;
    margin-right: 4px;
}

.rcp-row-slider-fill {
    display: block;
    height: 100%;
    background: #2563eb;
    border-radius: 2px;
    transition: width 0.1s ease-out;
}

.rcp-row-value-text {
    /* Bound text values can be longer than numbers — let them take up to
       half the row and ellipsis the rest. */
    max-width: 50%;
}

.rcp-row-value-date {
    /* Date values are typically 8–16 chars; monospace keeps columns aligned
       across rows when several date fields are listed together. */
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* Edit-mode visual: dim the result list so attention is on the input.
   Save-mode (preset naming) uses the same treatment. */
.rcp-popup.rcp-editing .rcp-results,
.rcp-popup.rcp-saving .rcp-results {
    opacity: 0.35;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.rcp-popup.rcp-saving .rcp-input {
    background: #ecfdf5;
    color: #064e3b;
    border-bottom-color: #10b981;
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #10b981;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-popup.rcp-saving .rcp-input {
        background: #022c22;
        color: #d1fae5;
        border-bottom-color: #34d399;
        box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #34d399;
    }
}

/* Parse-error state when committing a date / smart-parsed value fails —
   the input picks up a red bottom edge to signal "fix this and retry". */
.rcp-input.rcp-edit-error {
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #dc2626;
    border-bottom-color: #dc2626;
}

.rcp-popup.rcp-editing .rcp-input {
    background: #fef3c7;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    border-bottom-color: #f59e0b;
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #f59e0b;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-popup.rcp-editing .rcp-input {
        background: #422006;
        color: #fef3c7;
        border-bottom-color: #d97706;
        box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 0 #d97706;
    }
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-slider {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-slider-fill {
    background: #ffffff;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-row-slider {
        background: #374151;
    }
    .rcp-row-slider-fill {
        background: #60a5fa;
    }
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-value {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-row-checkbox {
        color: #9ca3af;
    }
    .rcp-row-checkbox-on {
        color: #60a5fa;
    }
    .rcp-row-value {
        color: #9ca3af;
    }
}

.rcp-row-chevron {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    color: #9ca3af;
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 16px;
}

.rcp-row-selected .rcp-row-chevron {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
}

.rcp-empty {
    padding: 18px 14px;
    text-align: center;
    color: #9ca3af;
    font-style: italic;

.rcp-group-header {
    padding: 6px 14px 2px;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    color: #9ca3af;

.rcp-group-header:not(:first-child) {

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .rcp-group-header {
        color: #6b7280;
    }
    .rcp-group-header:not(:first-child) {

.rcp-hint {

.rcp-perf-footer {

.rcp-detail-drawer{

/* Tab strip for multi-template details — clickable + keyboard-driven

.rcp-details-tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;

.rcp-details-tab {

/* ===== Leader strip ============================================
   Sits between viewconfig and input. Hidden via display:none until
   `.rcp-has-leaders` toggles it on (i.e. at least one leader is

/* The key chip — visually distinct so the reader registers it as

"},"$:/plugins/rimir/cascade-palette/test/test-axes.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/rimir/cascade-palette/test/test-axes.js","text":"/*\
title: $:/plugins/rimir/cascade-palette/test/test-axes.js
type: application/javascript
tags: [[$:/tags/test-spec]]

Tests for cp-axes pure functions: parseChainSpec, groupBy, sortGroups.

These are framework-free helpers that the engine uses for grouping rows
by derived keys. They have no dependencies on $tw.wiki state or DOM, so
they're trivially testable here.
\*/
"use strict";

describe("cascade-palette: cp-axes", function () {

    var axes = require("$:/plugins/rimir/cascade-palette/widgets/cp-axes");

    describe("parseChainSpec", function () {

        it("returns empty array for null/undefined/empty inputs", function () {
            expect(axes.parseChainSpec(null)).toEqual([]);
            expect(axes.parseChainSpec(undefined)).toEqual([]);
            expect(axes.parseChainSpec("")).toEqual([]);
            expect(axes.parseChainSpec("   ")).toEqual([]);
        });

        it("parses space-separated axis titles", function () {
            var spec = axes.parseChainSpec("axis-a axis-b axis-c");
            expect(spec.length).toBe(3);
            expect(spec[0]).toEqual({ title: "axis-a", params: null });
            expect(spec[1]).toEqual({ title: "axis-b", params: null });
            expect(spec[2]).toEqual({ title: "axis-c", params: null });
        });

        it("collapses multiple whitespace", function () {
            var spec = axes.parseChainSpec("  axis-a   axis-b\taxis-c  ");
            expect(spec.length).toBe(3);
        });

        it("parses JSON array of strings", function () {
            var spec = axes.parseChainSpec('["axis-a","axis-b"]');
            expect(spec.length).toBe(2);
            expect(spec[0]).toEqual({ title: "axis-a", params: null });
            expect(spec[1]).toEqual({ title: "axis-b", params: null });
        });

        it("parses JSON array of objects with params", function () {
            var spec = axes.parseChainSpec(
                '[{"title":"by-field","params":{"field":"status"}},{"title":"by-year"}]'
            );
            expect(spec.length).toBe(2);
            expect(spec[0].title).toBe("by-field");
            expect(spec[0].params).toEqual({ field: "status" });
            expect(spec[1].title).toBe("by-year");
            expect(spec[1].params).toBeNull();
        });

        it("filters out entries without a title", function () {
            var spec = axes.parseChainSpec('[{"title":"a"},{"params":{"x":1}},{"title":"b"}]');
            expect(spec.length).toBe(2);
            expect(spec[0].title).toBe("a");
            expect(spec[1].title).toBe("b");
        });

        it("falls back to space-separated on malformed JSON", function () {
            // Open bracket but invalid JSON — falls through to space-split.
            var spec = axes.parseChainSpec("[bad json");
            expect(spec.length).toBe(2);
            expect(spec[0].title).toBe("[bad");
            expect(spec[1].title).toBe("json");
        });
    });

    describe("groupBy", function () {

        it("returns [] for empty input", function () {
            var groups = axes.groupBy([], function (x) { return x; });
            expect(groups).toEqual([]);
        });

        it("groups items by key in first-seen order", function () {
            var items = ["a1", "b1", "a2", "c1", "b2"];
            var groups = axes.groupBy(items, function (s) { return s.charAt(0); });
            expect(groups.length).toBe(3);
            expect(groups[0].key).toBe("a");
            expect(groups[0].items).toEqual(["a1", "a2"]);
            expect(groups[1].key).toBe("b");
            expect(groups[1].items).toEqual(["b1", "b2"]);
            expect(groups[2].key).toBe("c");
            expect(groups[2].items).toEqual(["c1"]);
        });

        it("collapses empty/null/undefined keys to UNSET_KEY", function () {
            var items = ["a", "b", "c"];
            var keys = ["X", null, ""];
            var groups = axes.groupBy(items, function (s) {
                return keys[items.indexOf(s)];
            });
            expect(groups.length).toBe(2);
            var unsetGroup = groups.filter(function (g) { return g.key === axes.UNSET_KEY; })[0];
            expect(unsetGroup).toBeDefined();
            expect(unsetGroup.items.length).toBe(2);
            expect(unsetGroup.items.indexOf("b")).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
            expect(unsetGroup.items.indexOf("c")).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
        });
    });

    describe("sortGroups", function () {

        function makeEntries(keys) {
            return keys.map(function (k) { return { key: k, label: k, count: 1 }; });
        }

        it("first-seen / no axis = no change", function () {
            var entries = makeEntries(["c", "a", "b"]);
            axes.sortGroups(entries, { sort: "first-seen" });
            expect(entries.map(function (e) { return e.key; })).toEqual(["c", "a", "b"]);
        });

        it("asc = locale-compare ascending", function () {
            var entries = makeEntries(["c", "a", "b"]);
            axes.sortGroups(entries, { sort: "asc" });
            expect(entries.map(function (e) { return e.key; })).toEqual(["a", "b", "c"]);
        });

        it("desc = locale-compare descending", function () {
            var entries = makeEntries(["a", "c", "b"]);
            axes.sortGroups(entries, { sort: "desc" });
            expect(entries.map(function (e) { return e.key; })).toEqual(["c", "b", "a"]);
        });

        it("enum = explicit order from sortKeys, unknowns at end alpha", function () {
            var entries = makeEntries(["high", "low", "unknown", "normal"]);
            axes.sortGroups(entries, {
                sort: "enum",
                sortKeys: ["low", "normal", "high"]
            });
            expect(entries.map(function (e) { return e.key; }))
                .toEqual(["low", "normal", "high", "unknown"]);
        });
    });
});
